author: ThioJoe
description:
The new recaptcha system means privacy is truly dead.

Google is rolling out a change to their recaptcha service which will means that the usual bot challenges of things like "click the pictures of the traffic light" will be replaced with you needing to scan a QR code with your phone. But the problem is it will only work with "supported" phones, meaning either Android or Google. Anyone with another type of phone is out of luck, and even still, your privacy is completely stripped away.
